Project Summary: Martial Map: A Survival Guide
Team: Proxima Centuri | Event: NASA Space Apps Challenge

The Challenge
Human exploration of Mars faces life-threatening environmental hazards—including intense cosmic radiation, violent dust storms, treacherous crater slopes, and scarce accessible water ice. Astronauts and mission planners need a unified, intuitive tool to navigate these dangers and locate vital resources in real time.

Our Solution
Martial Map: A Survival Guide is an interactive planetary terrain intelligence and mission survival planner powered by open NASA Mars datasets. Designed as an actionable digital field atlas, it translates complex orbital and rover telemetry into clear visual survival guidance.

Key Features
Hazard Heatmaps: Visualizes high-risk zones for solar radiation, thermal extremes, and seasonal dust storm corridors.

Resource Locator: Pinpoints promising deposits of subsurface water ice, sheltered lava tubes, and usable mineral sites.

Safe Traverse Routing: Calculates slope-safe, energy-efficient paths for rovers and EVA crews moving between habitats and waypoints.

Field Survival Protocols: Provides instant, context-aware emergency checklists tailored to the specific terrain and environmental risks of any selected map coordinate.
